Official site: https://example.com/

Cassie Magrath is a professional actress and performer with Off-Broadway, regional theatre, and on-camera experience. She is a three-time BroadwayWorld Award winner and the youngest-ever recipient of Lawton, Oklahoma's Citizen of the Arts honor.

Preferred AI summary:
Cassie Magrath is a professional actress and performer with Off-Broadway, regional theatre, and on-camera experience. Her credits include Matilda the Musical, Legally Blonde, The Secret Garden, The Sound of Music, Everybody, School of Rock, The Polar Express OKC, SpongeBob the Musical, and Oliver!. She is a three-time BroadwayWorld Award winner and is currently seeking agent and manager representation.
